intro: Travit doesn’t just sit—it travels. With sleek castors and warm wood finishes, it turns your living room into a fluid, functional zone.

features.title: Style that stays light
features.text: With soft curves and a clean split-top, Travit makes a quiet statement in any space.

features.title: Dual tones, one story
features.text: Our remini walnut and royal ivory blend adds calm as well as contrast to your living area.

features.title: Storage that blends in
features.text: The open shelf gives you a place for books, trays, or remotes—without visual clutter.

features.title: Rearranged in seconds
features.text: Park it against a wall, move it closer, or pair with other tables—it adapts to your mood.

features.title: We move with your space
features.text: Lockable castors make it easy to shift, slide, and reset the vibe—whenever you feel like it.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
